mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM job_execution WHERE status IN ('PENDING','RUNNING','CANCEL_REQUESTED','TIMEOUT_REQUESTED')) AS active_jobs, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM research_validation_task WHERE status IN ('PENDING','RUNNING','CANCEL_REQUESTED','TIMEOUT_REQUESTED')) AS active_validations, COALESCE((SELECT used_bytes FROM storage_budget WHERE scope_id=#{scope}),0) AS evidence_bytes, (SELECT MIN(created_at) FROM job_execution WHERE status='PENDING') AS oldest_pending_at
SELECT id FROM app_user WHERE id=#{userId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT COALESCE((SELECT used_bytes FROM storage_budget WHERE scope_id=#{scope}),0) AS used_bytes,COALESCE((SELECT reserved_bytes FROM storage_budget WHERE scope_id=#{scope}),0) AS reserved_bytes,(SELECT limit_bytes FROM storage_budget WHERE scope_id=-1) AS limit_bytes,0 AS database_allocated_bytes
